integrity: The limiting theorem is established analytically; finite enumeration is corroboration only. The antecedent forest enumeration and Stam sampling are explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Fixed number of equivalence relations; the graph must be a forest; moving-parameter Poisson approximation; possible older equivalent rare-event formulation under graphical Bell or occupancy terminology.
title: Uniform Poisson collision profiles and sharp avoidance probabilities for random equivalence relations on forests
